pairs.target: dìjiǔtiān , lí wǎnfàn hái zǎo , tǎ wéi jiù dào le běi gōng fāng .
pairs.english: On the ninth day, Tavi reached the north workshop well before supper.
pairs.hanzi: 第九天，离晚饭还早，塔维就到了北工坊。

pairs.target: ménkǒu de shuǐlún chóngxīn zhuǎn le , mùyè fān qǐlái , bǎ shuǐ yìgǔ gǔ dǎo jìn ànqú .
pairs.english: The waterwheel by the door was turning again, wooden paddles rising and pouring streams into the covered channel.
pairs.hanzi: 门口的水轮重新转了，木叶翻起来，把水一股股倒进暗渠。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài qiáobǎn shàng kàn le yíhuìer , děng yígè tuīchē de rén guòqù , cái jìnmén .
pairs.english: He watched from the bridge boards a while, waiting for someone pushing a cart to pass before going inside.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在桥板上看了一会儿，等一个推车的人过去，才进门。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu zuòzài shàng huí de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Nerai wasn't sitting in last time's place.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有坐在上回的位置。

pairs.target: tā zài lǐjiān de cháng zhuōqián , miànqián pái zhe qīzhī qiǎndié , dié lǐ quán shì ní .
pairs.english: She was at the inner room's long table, with seven shallow dishes of mud lined up before her.
pairs.hanzi: 她在里间的长桌前，面前排着七只浅碟，碟里全是泥。

pairs.target: yǒu de jié zhe yìngké , yǒu de yǐjīng suìchéng fěn , yìzhī diézǐ shàng dǎokòu zhe bēizi .
pairs.english: Some had hard crusts, some had crumbled to powder; an upturned cup sat on one dish.
pairs.hanzi: 有的结着硬壳，有的已经碎成粉，一只碟子上倒扣着杯子。

pairs.target: " nàge biédòng , " tā shuō , " wǒ hái xiǎng hēshuǐ . "
pairs.english: “Leave that one,” she said. “I still want to drink from it.”
pairs.hanzi: “那个别动，”她说，“我还想喝水。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shēn dào yíbàn de shǒu suōhuílái , qù bān qiángbiān de dèngzǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi drew back his half-outstretched hand and went for the stool by the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把伸到一半的手缩回来，去搬墙边的凳子。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ le zhǐ lìng yìbǎ . dìyībǎ shǎo le yìkē dīng , zuòshàngqù huì wǎng zuǒ wāi .
pairs.english: She pointed to another. The first lacked a nail and tilted left when sat on.
pairs.hanzi: 她指了指另一把。第一把少了一颗钉，坐上去会往左歪。

pairs.target: zhuōbiān yǒu yìtuán guǒ zhe zhǐ de huīhèsè ní , xiàng cóng xiédǐ guāxiàlái de .
pairs.english: At the table's edge lay a paper-wrapped lump of grey-brown mud, as if scraped from a sole.
pairs.hanzi: 桌边有一团裹着纸的灰褐色泥，像从鞋底刮下来的。

pairs.target: tā jìde zài huī ào shí , tā yě bǎ yīfu shàng shuā xià de ní liúxià guò .
pairs.english: He remembered her keeping mud brushed from her clothes in Ash Hollow too.
pairs.hanzi: 他记得在灰坳时，她也把衣服上刷下的泥留下过。

pairs.target: " nǐ yìzhí dài zhe ? " " lùshang dài huílái , dào le zhèlǐ cái yǒu dìfāng fēn . "
pairs.english: “You've carried it all along?” “Brought it back from the road. Only here have I room to sort it.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你一直带着？”
“路上带回来，到了这里才有地方分。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ diézǐ nuó jìn chuāng biān . měi zhī dié xià dōu yā zhe zhǐtiáo , yǒu rìqī , háiyǒu tā bú rènshi de dìmíng .
pairs.english: She moved the dishes toward the window. Under each was a slip with a date and a place name he didn't recognize.
pairs.hanzi: 她把碟子挪近窗边。每只碟下都压着纸条，有日期，还有他不认识的地名。

pairs.target: báisè shālì zài yìduī shēn ní zhōng géwài xiǎnyǎn .
pairs.english: White grains stood out sharply in a heap of dark mud.
pairs.hanzi: 白色砂粒在一堆深泥中格外显眼。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ dìyīcì jiàn tā , nà jié lièkāi de zhǐjiǎ xià yě qiàn zhe zhèyàng de bái .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered their first meeting: the same white had lodged under her split nail.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起第一次见她，那截裂开的指甲下也嵌着这样的白。

pairs.target: " zhè shì shénme dìfāng de ? " " zhè dié shì jiù hékǒu . biéde dìfāng yě yǒu báishā , guāng kàn yánsè rènbùchūlái . "
pairs.english: “Where's this from?” “This dish is from Old Rivermouth. Other places have white sand too; you can't tell just by color.”
pairs.hanzi:
“这是什么地方的？”
“这碟是旧河口。别的地方也有白砂，光看颜色认不出来。”

pairs.target: tā dǎo yìdiǎn shuǐ , bǎ jiékuài pàokāi , yòng xì mùpiàn qīngqīng tuī .
pairs.english: She poured in a little water, soaked the clumps apart, and nudged them gently with a thin wooden sliver.
pairs.hanzi: 她倒一点水，把结块泡开，用细木片轻轻推。

pairs.target: shā chénxiàqù , jǐgēn xì xiānwéi què fú qǐlái , tiē zài shuǐmiàn shàng , xiàng duàndiào de jiémáo .
pairs.english: The sand sank, but fine fibers floated on the surface like broken eyelashes.
pairs.hanzi: 砂沉下去，几根细纤维却浮起来，贴在水面上，像断掉的睫毛。

pairs.target: " cǎogēn ? " tǎ wéi wèn . " yǒuxiē shì . yǒu yìgēn kěnéng shì shéng . wǒ hái méi fēnqīng . "
pairs.english: “Grass roots?” Tavi asked. “Some. One might be cord. I haven't sorted it out yet.”
pairs.hanzi:
“草根？”塔维问。
“有些是。有一根可能是绳。我还没分清。”

pairs.target: tā còujìn le kàn . nài lěi bǎ diézǐ rànggěi tā , zìjǐ zhuǎn qù xǐshǒu .
pairs.english: He leaned closer. Nerai left him the dish and turned to wash her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 他凑近了看。奈蕾把碟子让给他，自己转去洗手。

pairs.target: tā yuányǐwéi yuèjiè kè dài huílái de dōngxī gāi yòng xiāngzǐ suǒ zhe , huòshì ná hòu bù gàizhù , méixiǎngdào zhè jǐ dié ní jiù bǎizài pò dèngzǐ pángbiān .
pairs.english: He'd thought Outriders' finds should be locked in chests or covered with thick cloth, not sitting in dishes beside a broken stool.
pairs.hanzi: 他原以为越界客带回来的东西该用箱子锁着，或是拿厚布盖住，没想到这几碟泥就摆在破凳子旁边。

pairs.target: " nǐ ná tāmen zhǎo lù ma ? "
pairs.english: “Do you use them to find routes?”
pairs.hanzi: “你拿它们找路吗？”

pairs.target: " yǒushíhòu . yě kàn shuǐ zǒuguò nǎlǐ . shàngcì zǒuguò de dìfāng , xiàcì wèibì néng zhàozhe zǒu . "
pairs.english: “Sometimes. Also to see where water has been. Where you went last time may not be passable the same way next time.”
pairs.hanzi: “有时候。也看水走过哪里。上次走过的地方，下次未必能照着走。”

pairs.target: chuāngwài shuǐlún xiǎng le yíxià , tā táiqǐ tóu , tīngjiàn lúnzhóu jìxù zhuǎn , cái cāgān shǒu .
pairs.english: The wheel sounded outside. She looked up, heard the axle keep turning, then dried her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外水轮响了一下，她抬起头，听见轮轴继续转，才擦干手。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòng mùpiàn zhuī nàgēn fú zhe de xìsī , zhuī dào dié yán , chàdiǎn bǎ tā tiāo duàn .
pairs.english: Tavi chased the floating strand with the sliver to the dish's rim and almost broke it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维用木片追那根浮着的细丝，追到碟沿，差点把它挑断。

pairs.target: tā tíngxiàlái , bǎ mùpiàn fàng huí zhuōshàng . " wǒ xiǎoshíhòu zhù guò yìtái huòjī . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: He stopped and put the sliver back. “I lived in a freight machine when I was little,” he said.
pairs.hanzi:
他停下来，把木片放回桌上。
“我小时候住过一台货机。”他说。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhèngzài nǐng bù , tīngdào zhè jù , shǒumàn le xiàlái .
pairs.english: Nerai was wringing a cloth; hearing that, her hands slowed.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾正在拧布，听到这句，手慢了下来。

pairs.target: " zhù guò ? " " tāmen shuō shì zài lǐmiàn zhǎodào wǒ de . yě yǒurén shuō shìcóng lǐmiàn jiǎn chūlái de . wǒ bù zhīdào shìbushì tóngyì huíshì . "
pairs.english: “Lived?” “They say they found me inside. Others say I was picked out of it. I don't know if that's the same thing.”
pairs.hanzi:
“住过？”
“他们说是在里面找到我的。也有人说是从里面捡出来的。我不知道是不是同一回事。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán cái fāxiàn , " zhù guò " shì zìjǐ gāng tiān de . sè lā cónglái méiyǒu zhème shuō .
pairs.english: Only after speaking did he realize he'd just added “lived.” Sela had never said that.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完才发现，“住过”是自己刚添的。瑟拉从来没有这么说。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ bù guàdào chuāng gōu shàng , lākāi nà bǎ quē dīng de dèngzǐ , zìjǐ zuò le xiàqù .
pairs.english: Nerai hung the cloth on a window hook, pulled out the stool missing a nail, and sat on it herself.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把布挂到窗钩上，拉开那把缺钉的凳子，自己坐了下去。

pairs.target: dèngzǐ wāi le yíxià , tā yòng jiǎo dǐzhù zhuōtuǐ .
pairs.english: It tilted, and she braced a foot against the table leg.
pairs.hanzi: 凳子歪了一下，她用脚抵住桌腿。

pairs.target: " nǐ jìde lǐmiàn shénmeyàng ma ? " tǎ wéi yáotóu .
pairs.english: “Do you remember what it looked like inside?” Tavi shook his head.
pairs.hanzi:
“你记得里面什么样吗？”
塔维摇头。

pairs.target: biérén jiǎng dé duō le , yǒuxiē dōngxī hǎoxiàng néng xiǎng qǐlái , kě yí yàoshuō , jiù fēnbùchū nǎxiē shì tīng lái de .
pairs.english: He'd heard so many stories that some things seemed like memories, but when he tried to speak he couldn't separate them from what he'd been told.
pairs.hanzi: 别人讲得多了，有些东西好像能想起来，可一要说，就分不出哪些是听来的。

pairs.target: huī ào de jiùhuò jī tā jiàn guò bùshǎo , dǐxià yǒu hēiyóu , yǒushíhòu hái huì duǒ zhe māo .
pairs.english: He'd seen plenty of old freight machines in Ash Hollow, black oil underneath, sometimes a cat hiding there.
pairs.hanzi: 灰坳的旧货机他见过不少，底下有黑油，有时候还会躲着猫。

pairs.target: " nà xiān bié ná xiànzài jiàn guò de qù bǔ . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Then don't fill it in with things you've seen now,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “那先别拿现在见过的去补。”她说。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiēzhe wèn . tā fǎndǎo xiǎng jìxù shuō , què yòu zhǎo búdào yíjiàn quèdìng de shì .
pairs.english: She asked nothing more. He wanted to go on now, yet couldn't find a single certain thing to say.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有接着问。他反倒想继续说，却又找不到一件确定的事。

pairs.target: yuánxiān zàijiā shí , zhè zhǐshì ǒuěr bèi rén tíqǐ de jiù huà ;
pairs.english: At home, it had been just an old story people occasionally mentioned;
pairs.hanzi: 原先在家时，这只是偶尔被人提起的旧话；

pairs.target: dào le xuégōng , tiánguò nàxiē zhǐ , tā hūrán xiàng yīfu lǐ yìgēn yìng xiàn , píngshí bùjué , dòngyidòng jiù zhā yíxià .
pairs.english: at school, after filling those papers, it felt like a stiff thread in his clothes, unnoticed until a movement made it prick.
pairs.hanzi: 到了学宫，填过那些纸，它忽然像衣服里一根硬线，平时不觉，动一动就扎一下。

pairs.target: " huòjī shìbushì dōu yíyàng ? "
pairs.english: “Are freight machines all alike?”
pairs.hanzi: “货机是不是都一样？”

pairs.target: " chà dé hěn yuǎn . yùn kuàng de , yùn rén de , zǒu guǐ de , guà suǒ de . jiùshì de yě bùzhǐ yìzhǒng . "
pairs.english: “Very different. For ore or people, on rails or cables. There are several old types too.”
pairs.hanzi: “差得很远。运矿的、运人的，走轨的、挂索的。旧式的也不止一种。”

pairs.target: " wǒ néng kànkàn ma ? "
pairs.english: “Can I see some?”
pairs.hanzi: “我能看看吗？”

pairs.target: nài lěi xiǎng le yíhuìer , zhǐxiàng chuāngwài dōngbiān de wūdǐng .
pairs.english: Nerai thought a moment and pointed to the roofs east of the window.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾想了一会儿，指向窗外东边的屋顶。

pairs.target: " xuégōng yǒu jiān lù wù shì , shōu móxíng , yě shōu chāixiàlái de jiù jiàn .
pairs.english: “The school has a route collection: models, and old parts taken off machines.
pairs.hanzi: “学宫有间路物室，收模型，也收拆下来的旧件。

pairs.target: xià gè xiūxirì xiàwǔ , wǒ dàinǐqù . shì dìshísìtiān ba ? "
pairs.english: I'll take you next rest afternoon. That's day fourteen, isn't it?”
pairs.hanzi: 下个休息日下午，我带你去。是第十四天吧？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāi zhe zhǐtou shù , shù dào yíbàn , tā yǐjīng xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi counted on his fingers; halfway through, she was already laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维掰着指头数，数到一半，她已经笑了。

pairs.target: " wǒ yě jìbùqīng zhèlǐ zěnme páikè . nǐ huíqù kàn . "
pairs.english: “I can't keep track of the timetable here either. Check when you're back.”
pairs.hanzi: “我也记不清这里怎么排课。你回去看。”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , yòu wèn nàlǐ huì buhuì yǒu cóng shān wài dàilái de dōngxī .
pairs.english: He nodded, then asked if there were things brought from beyond the mountains.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，又问那里会不会有从山外带来的东西。

pairs.target: " yǒu . búguò méiyǒu yìtái jīqì néng tì nǐ shuōchū shì shuí bǎ nǐ fàngjìnqù de . "
pairs.english: “Yes. But no machine can tell you who put you inside.”
pairs.hanzi: “有。不过没有一台机器能替你说出是谁把你放进去的。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . " tā shuō dé tài kuài , biàn yòu bǔ le yíjù , " wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng kànkàn . "
pairs.english: “I know.” He said it too quickly, then added, “I just want to look.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。”他说得太快，便又补了一句，“我只是想看看。”

pairs.target: nài lěi méi chāichuān tā .
pairs.english: Nerai didn't call him on it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没拆穿他。

pairs.target: tā bǎ nà zhī shèng zhe xiānwéi de diézǐ yí dào yìpáng , ná qǐ hēshuǐ de bēizi , fāxiàn bēidǐ yě zhān le ní , zhǐhǎo chóngxīn zhàn qǐlái .
pairs.english: She set the dish of fibers aside and picked up her drinking cup, found mud on its bottom too, and had to get up again.
pairs.hanzi: 她把那只盛着纤维的碟子移到一旁，拿起喝水的杯子，发现杯底也沾了泥，只好重新站起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fúzhù nà bǎ wāi dèng , miǎnde tā gēnzhe tā dǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi steadied the crooked stool so it wouldn't topple after her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维扶住那把歪凳，免得它跟着她倒。

pairs.target: tā xǐ bēizi de shíhòu , tā bǎ quē dīng de dìfāng cháowài zhuǎn , ràng xià yígè rén yìyǎn jiù kànjiàn .
pairs.english: While she washed the cup, he turned the missing nail outward where the next person could see it immediately.
pairs.hanzi: 她洗杯子的时候，他把缺钉的地方朝外转，让下一个人一眼就看见。

pairs.target: chū le gōng fāng , tā méiyǒu lìkè huí qǐn fáng .
pairs.english: Outside the workshop, he didn't go straight back to his room.
pairs.hanzi: 出了工坊，他没有立刻回寝房。

pairs.target: shuǐ lúndǐxià búduàn yǒu xīn shuǐyǒng guòlái , shuǐ lǐ shénme yě fēnbiàn bù chū .
pairs.english: Fresh water kept surging beneath the wheel; he couldn't distinguish anything in it.
pairs.hanzi: 水轮底下不断有新水涌过来，水里什么也分辨不出。

pairs.target: tā yánzhe qú biān mànmàn zǒu , xiǎngqǐ nài lěi wèn de nàge zì : zhù .
pairs.english: Walking slowly along the channel, he thought of the word Nerai had questioned: lived.
pairs.hanzi: 他沿着渠边慢慢走，想起奈蕾问的那个字：住。

pairs.target: búshì zhǎodào , búshì jiǎn dào . nàge zì shì tā zìjǐ shuō de .
pairs.english: Not found, not picked up. That word had been his own.
pairs.hanzi: 不是找到，不是捡到。那个字是他自己说的。
